results.title: Education, health and care plans

results.title: Special educational needs in England
results.summary: Pupils in England with SEN support or an education, health and care (EHC) plan . Including type of need, age, sex, free school meals (FSM) and ethnicity.

results.title: Early years foundation stage profile results
results.summary: Annual statistics on early years foundation stage profile assessments in England relating to the 7 areas of learning and the 17 early learning goals.

results.title: Schools, pupils and their characteristics
results.summary: School and pupil statistics for England including age, gender, free school meals (FSM), ethnicity, English as additional language (EAL), class size.

results.title: Outcomes for children in need, including children looked after by local authorities in England
results.summary: Children in need, including children looked after by local authorities in England, national and local authority level outcomes including key stage 4 and absence

results.title: Apprenticeships
results.summary: Apprenticeship starts, achievements and participation. Includes breakdowns by age, sex, ethnicity, subject, provider, geography etc.

results.title: Key stage 2 attainment
results.summary: Key stage 2 attainment statistics by pupil characteristics, school characteristics, region and local authority.

results.title: Phonics screening check attainment
results.summary: Phonics screening check attainment statistics of pupils in England by pupil characteristics, school characteristics, region and local authority.

results.title: Key stage 4 performance
results.summary: GCSE results of pupils at the end of KS4 attending state-funded schools in England at national & LA level. This release includes pupil characteristic breakdowns

results.title: Funded early education and childcare
results.summary: Annual January statistics on children under 5 registered for government funded entitlements in England, and on providers and staff delivering them.

results.title: Pupil absence in schools in England
results.summary: Pupil absence, including overall, authorised and unauthorised absence and persistent absence by reason and pupil characteristics for the full academic year.

results.title: Children in need
results.summary: Statistics on children in need in England, including child protection plans and referrals to and assessments completed by children’s social care services.

results.title: Longer term destinations

results.title: Children looked after in England including adoptions
results.summary: Children looked after, care leavers and children adopted in England. Annual statistics including characteristics, placement information and health outcomes.

results.title: 16-19 destination measures
results.summary: Students sustaining an education, apprenticeship or employment destination after 16-19 study in England. Includes disadvantage, ethnicity and other breakdowns.

results.title: Further education workforce
results.summary: This annual official statistics release includes data on the further education workforce and governors in England.

results.title: Elective home education
results.summary: This publication provides data reported by local authorities on children in elective home education (EHE) in England.

results.title: Children missing education
results.summary: This publication provides data reported by local authorities on children missing education (CME) in England.
